purpose: Explicit, reviewable label corrections applied by build_training_set.py after merging the source files. Source files stay as originally authored; every deviation from them is recorded here with a reason so it can be audited or reverted individually.
status: UNVERIFIED -- needs a human pass. Each entry is a judgement call, not a fact.

regulatory_rule.statement: Apply Regulatory when an external legal or regulatory mandate is the reason the requirement exists -- not merely because the data or the domain is regulated.
regulatory_rule.derived_from: The convention actually used in ground_truth.json, which is the held-out eval set and therefore defines the target. It was inferred, not documented, so it is an interpretation.
applies: KYC / AML identity duties (eKYC, V-CIP, Aadhaar verification, PEP and sanctions screening)
regulator-facing reporting (CTR, STR, compliance returns, ombudsman escalation)
a named external standard dictating the control (PCI-DSS TLS levels, RBI Key Fact Statement, SEBI circuit breakers, WCAG where legally mandated)
mandated disclosures to the customer (total cost of credit, fee and interest terms)
does_not_apply: integrating with regulated national payment infrastructure where the requirement is the plumbing itself -- ground_truth REQ-030 integrates with the NPCI UPI switch and is NOT Regulatory, while REQ-022 integrates with UIDAI Aadhaar for identity verification and IS

general security controls with no named mandate -- ground_truth REQ-008 encrypts PII at rest with AES-256 and is NOT Regulatory, while REQ-029 mandates TLS 1.2+ for payment data (a PCI-DSS level) and IS
internal access logging -- ground_truth REQ-020 logs KYC document access and is NOT Regulatory, while REQ-028 requires an immutable payment audit trail and IS
performance, availability, and operational limits, even on a regulated rail
regulatory_rule.known_tension: The REQ-008 / REQ-029 and REQ-020 / REQ-028 pairs in ground_truth.json are hard to separate on the text alone. The rule above is the best fit to that eval set, but the boundary is genuinely blurry and is a ceiling on how well any model can score this category.

corrections.reason: EPFO integration is fetching employment data for underwriting. The data source is government-run, but no mandate requires this check -- parallels ground_truth REQ-003 (fetch CIBIL scores), which is not Regulatory.

Supporting RTGS transfers is payment-rail plumbing with a settlement-time characteristic. RBI operates RTGS, but the requirement is functional/performance -- parallels ground_truth REQ-030 (NPCI UPI switch integration), which is not Regulatory.
Multi-currency accounts and live forex conversion. FEMA governs the domain, but the statement describes a product feature, not a compliance duty.
Routing mutual fund orders via BSE StAR MF / NSE NMF is exchange plumbing -- the same category as REQ-030's UPI switch integration.
Active-active geographic redundancy is a pure availability requirement. RBI does mandate DR posture for banks, but nothing in the statement ties it to that mandate.
A 15-second UPI response target is a performance SLA on a regulated rail, not a compliance duty.
Capping transaction-status checks at 3 attempts per 90 seconds is an operational rate limit.
